reason: A macOS-only dsh Cordis plugin that replaces the deprecated sandbox-exec command path with a native libsandbox loader for sandboxed command execution; the README states it is unpublished and not yet ready for production use.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS Seatbelt 沙箱适配，通过原生 loader 调用 libsandbox 来限制目标命令的文件访问和执行环境。
summaries.en: Provides a macOS Seatbelt sandbox adapter for DeepSeek Harness by using a native loader to apply libsandbox profiles to target commands.

capabilities: Executes target commands through a native macOS loader
Applies macOS Seatbelt sandbox profiles to child processes
Generates and passes SBPL policy profiles
Detects loader availability and fails closed when unavailable
Uses a private macOS libsandbox API through a native binary
